zh.summary: 印尼经济学家对该国的雄心勃勃的增长目标持怀疑态度，理由是对财政纪律和赤字管理的担忧。这场辩论突显了激进的经济扩张与维持可持续财政政策之间的紧张关系。

title: Oil falls as the U.S. pivots to economic pressure on Iran
summary: Oil prices declined as the U.S. shifted strategy toward economic sanctions instead of military action against Iran, reducing geopolitical risk premiums. This policy change reflects a more measured approach to Iranian tensions with direct commodity market implications.
content: Oil fell Wednesday, as investors continue to assess the U.S. pivot toward economic sanctions rather than military strikes to add pressure on Iran.

zh.title: 油价下跌：美国转向对伊朗的经济压力
zh.summary: 随着美国将战略转向经济制裁而非对伊朗的军事行动，油价下跌，地缘政治风险溢价随之下降。这一政策转变反映了对伊朗紧张局势采取更为谨慎的态度，对商品市场产生直接影响。

title: Fidelity says this phenomenon is 'reshaping markets' and recommends stocks to fight it off
summary: Fidelity identifies structural inflation driven by government spending, AI investment, tight labor markets, protectionism, and energy constraints as reshaping markets. The investment firm recommends equities as a hedge against this persistent inflation environment.
content: Structural inflation, fueled by government deficits, AI investments, low unemployment, trade barriers and energy disruptions, is reshaping markets.

zh.title: 富达表示这一现象正"重塑市场"，建议投资股票应对
zh.summary: 富达将由政府支出、人工智能投资、劳动力市场紧张、贸易保护主义和能源约束驱动的结构性通胀视为"重塑市场"的因素。该投资公司建议投资股票作为对冲手段，以应对这种持久的通胀环境。

title: HP partners with U.S.-blacklisted Huawei for licensing the Chinese company's WiFi tech
summary: HP has licensed WiFi technology from Huawei, signaling growing adoption of the Chinese firm's technology despite U.S. trade restrictions. This partnership demonstrates how restricted companies can still penetrate markets through alternative channels and licensing arrangements.
content: It's a sign of adoption of Huawei technology outside China, despite the U.S. restricting the company from working with American suppliers such as Google.

zh.title: 惠普与美国黑名单上的华为合作，授权其WiFi技术
zh.summary: 惠普已从华为授权WiFi技术，这表明尽管美国贸易限制，该中国企业技术的采用正在增长。这一合作伙伴关系表明受制裁企业如何通过替代渠道和授权协议继续打入市场。

title: Why Tesla has been caught up in a massive car recall in China
summary: China has launched its largest-ever vehicle recall, affecting over four million cars from Tesla, XPeng, Xiaomi, and other manufacturers. The massive recall highlights quality control challenges and regulatory enforcement in the rapidly growing Chinese EV market.
content: The country's biggest ever car recall affects more than four million vehicles made by Tesla, XPeng, Xiaomi and other firms.

zh.title: 为什么特斯拉陷入中国大规模汽车召回风波
zh.summary: 中国启动了有史以来规模最大的车辆召回，涉及特斯拉、小鹏、小米等制造商的400多万辆汽车。这次大规模召回凸显了快速增长的中国电动汽车市场中的质量控制挑战和监管执法问题。

title: Trump's Saudi nuclear deal reaches Congress as experts warn of proliferation risk
summary: A proposed Saudi nuclear agreement has drawn criticism from Democratic lawmakers and nonproliferation experts over the absence of permanent restrictions on uranium enrichment and reprocessing. The dispute reflects broader concerns about nuclear proliferation risks in Middle Eastern policy.
content: Some Democratic lawmakers and nonproliferation advocates have criticized the pact for not including a permanent prohibition on enrichment or reprocessing.

zh.title: 特朗普沙特核交易提交国会，专家警告扩散风险
zh.summary: 一项提议的沙特核协议因缺乏对铀浓缩和后处理的永久限制而遭到民主党议员和核不扩散专家的批评。这一争议反映了中东政策中对核扩散风险的更广泛担忧。

title: Are older Americans spoiling the economy for everyone else?
summary: An analysis explores how unlocking seniors' $12 trillion in home equity could boost economic spending and growth. The piece addresses demographic trends where older Americans' wealth concentration significantly affects broader economic dynamics.
content: How to get seniors to spend $12 trillion in home equity.

zh.title: 美国老年人是否在为其他人毁掉经济？
zh.summary: 一项分析探讨了如何释放老年人12万亿美元的房产净值以促进经济支出和增长。这篇文章涉及一个人口趋势，即美国老年人的财富集中度对更广泛的经济动态产生重大影响。

title: 5 cheap U.S. cities to retire in — if you can deal with this one thing
summary: The article profiles affordable U.S. retirement destinations, each with distinct trade-offs to consider alongside lower costs. It reflects growing interest in domestic alternatives as seniors seek to maximize purchasing power in retirement.
content: You don’t have to leave the country to find an affordable place that matches your retirement vision.

zh.title: 5个美国便宜退休城市——如果你能接受这一点的话
zh.summary: 该文章介绍了美国经济实惠的退休目的地，每个目的地都有需要考虑的独特权衡。它反映了老年人在寻求最大化退休购买力时对国内替代方案日益增长的兴趣。

title: Musk's rocket firm SpaceX to build $100bn launch facility
summary: SpaceX is constructing a $100 billion launch facility, its largest to date, with plans to begin operations in 2029. The mega-facility represents a major expansion of launch capacity and ambitions for increased commercial space access.
content: It will be the firm's biggest site yet and aims to send rockets to space in 2029.

zh.title: 马斯克火箭公司SpaceX将建造100亿美元发射设施
zh.summary: SpaceX正在建造一个价值100亿美元的发射设施，这是迄今为止最大的设施，计划于2029年开始运营。这个超级设施代表了发射能力的重大扩展，以及增加商业太空进入的雄心壮志。

title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await key inflation report, Nvidia earnings: Live updates
summary: Markets are stabilizing as investors focus on two key triggers—inflation data and Nvidia's earnings—both scheduled for Wednesday, which could significantly influence near-term trading direction.
content: Traders awaited inflation data along with Nvidia's latest quarterly results. Both are due Wednesday.

zh.title: 股指期货涨跌不大，交易员等待关键通胀报告和英伟达财报：实时更新
zh.summary: 市场趋于稳定，投资者关注两个关键因素——通胀数据和英伟达财报——两者均定于周三公布，可能会显著影响短期交易方向。

title: Amazon service Bezos once called 'artificial artificial intelligence' is shutting down
summary: Amazon is discontinuing Mechanical Turk, a 21-year-old crowdsourcing platform that Bezos humorously called 'artificial artificial intelligence' for handling human-solvable tasks computers couldn't automate.
content: Mechanical Turk launched in 2005 as a way to farm out tasks that are easy for humans to complete but too challenging for computers.

zh.title: 贝索斯曾称为"人工人工智能"的亚马逊服务正在关闭
zh.summary: 亚马逊正在停止运营有21年历史的众包平台Mechanical Turk，贝索斯幽默地将其称为"人工人工智能"，用于处理计算机无法自动化的人类可解决的任务。

title: From military alliance to economic partnership: How Trump is redefining U.S.-South Korea ties
summary: The Trump administration is shifting U.S.-South Korea relations from military focus to economic partnership, directing reduced joint military exercises due to cost concerns and diplomatic sensitivity toward North Korea.
content: Trump last Sunday instructed the Pentagon to cut military drills because they were "costly" and send "inappropriate and hostile" signals to North Korea.

zh.title: 从军事联盟到经济伙伴关系：特朗普如何重新定义美韩关系
zh.summary: 特朗普政府正在将美韩关系从军事焦点转向经济伙伴关系，指示减少联合军事演习，原因是成本考虑和对朝鲜的外交敏感性。
